breaking_changes: Removed the --no-sign flag from the release tagging tool; omit the flag (now the default) or use --sign for signed tags.

checklist.author: @abn
checklist.text: On a Linux or macOS desktop without lemond running, launch lemonade-tray with --spawn-server and verify that lemond starts within 15 seconds, the tray menu populates, and quitting the tray causes lemond to terminate immediately without leaving an orphan process.

checklist.author: @RaulMermans
checklist.text: Run lemonade config set flm.flm_bin=builtin and confirm it returns an Unknown key error, then run lemonade config set flm.npu_bin=builtin and confirm it succeeds.

checklist.author: @Copilot
checklist.text: Run the release tagging tool in dry-run mode and confirm the output says 'would create and push annotated tag' rather than 'signed tag'.

checklist.author: @Copilot
checklist.text: Run the release tagging tool with the --sign flag in dry-run mode and confirm the output says 'would create and push signed tag'.

evidence.blockers: Three manual checks needed: the --spawn-server end-to-end tray-to-lemond lifecycle on a POSIX desktop, release tagging tool dry-run in both default and --sign modes, and config validation exercised through the user-facing `lemonade config set` CLI.
evidence.breaking_changes: The --no-sign flag is removed from the release tagging tool CLI; operators should omit it or use --sign. No end-user-facing breaking changes.
evidence.coverage: All 13 commits in the range v2026.40.0..6f8e87b reviewed. CI passed across all relevant workflows for each commit. No gaps identified in the review evidence.
evidence.manual_testing: (1) Launch lemonade-tray --spawn-server on a POSIX desktop and verify lemond starts, the tray menu populates, and quitting the tray terminates lemond without orphan. (2) Run the release tagging tool in dry-run and with --sign dry-run to confirm output messages. (3) Test `lemonade config set` with invalid FLM keys (should error) and valid keys (should succeed).
evidence.security: No security concerns observed. The watchdog pipe uses FD_CLOEXEC and posix_spawn_file_actions_addclose for safe subprocess isolation. Config validation is tightened, which is a defensive improvement.
